# β distance matrices
![](images/measuring_tape_2.png){style="width:300px; border-radius:5px; background:white; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

Here we'll find out how to produce a paired distance matrix with our __beta diversity__ metric of choice using the [`rbiom`](https://cmmr.github.io/rbiom/) package. 
Along with many other functions it is able to calculate all the beta diversity metrics we are interested.
These include:

- Weighted and Unweighted UniFrac
- Bray-curtis
- Jaccard

However, the `rbiom` package requires its input to be in the rbiom format.

## phyloseq to rbiom

Thankfully we can easily convert our `phyloseq` object to an `r_biom` with [`rbiom::as_rbiom()`](https://cmmr.github.io/rbiom/reference/as_rbiom.html).

Run the function to see the summary of the produced `r_biom` object.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
rbiom::as_rbiom(pseq)
```

You'll notice that the `r_biom` object contains the phylogenetic tree in our `phyloseq` object.
This means we can use it for UniFrac distance calculations.

::: {.callout-note}
We have not created a variable with the rbiom object. INstead we'll use this function within the functions to calculate beta diversity.
:::

## Distance dissimilarity matrix
![](images/weighted_blanket.png){style="width:200px; border-radius:5px; background:white; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}


The function [`rbiom::bdiv_matrix()`](https://cmmr.github.io/rbiom/reference/bdiv_table.html) can calculate many different many different beta diversity distances.
Additionally, the output is a matrix which we need for our ordination step later on.
This is perfect for our downstream rarefaction, ordinations, and stats.

Calculate weighted Unifrac distances by specifying the parameter `bdiv="weighted_unifrac"`.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
#Calculate Weighted UniFrac values
unifrac_rbiom_microbiome <- 
    rbiom::bdiv_matrix(
        #Phyloseq to rbiom
        biom = rbiom::as_rbiom(pseq),
        bdiv="weighted_unifrac")
#Check the first 6 rows and columns of the resulting distance matrix
unifrac_rbiom_microbiome[1:6,1:6]
```

::: {.callout-tip}
For a full list of the distances see the [`rbiom::bdiv_matrix()` reference page](https://cmmr.github.io/rbiom/reference/bdiv_table.html).

Distances include:

- Weighted UniFrac = `weighted_unifrac`
- Unweighted UniFrac = `unweighted_unifrac`
- Bray-Curtis = `bray`
- Jaccard = `jaccard`
:::
